questions.question: Which strategy category involves planning, monitoring and evaluating your own learning?
questions.explanation: Metacognitive strategies are about thinking about your learning: planning it, monitoring progress and evaluating results.

questions.question: What are the four pillars of language proficiency?
questions.explanation: The four core skills are listening, speaking, reading and writing — strategies should develop all of them.

questions.question: Taking notes, making word associations and practising structures belong to which strategy type?
questions.explanation: Cognitive strategies involve working directly with the language itself — notes, associations and practice.

questions.question: What is the main message about strategic versus passive learning?
options: Actively choosing and applying strategies is more effective than passive studying
questions.explanation: The most successful language learners actively choose and apply appropriate strategies rather than studying passively.

questions.question: Joining a conversation group to practise English is an example of which strategy type?
questions.explanation: Social strategies involve learning through interaction with other people.
